title: Real Lab Word Math × Connected Systems: five attachments
question: How do the actual Lab Word Math semantics and Connected Systems First policy behave when joined to mission gates, multi-organ validation, bioelectric health, goal gravity and causal composition?
summary: Five Lab-backed comparison probes are built. Current private Lab master was inspected and 18 expected implementation/policy signatures verified, but the actual runtime probes cannot execute from this ChatGPT sandbox. No outcome claims or Lab changes.

evidence.environment: GitHub connected read of private Lab master at e3b08828522ecf6e0ffb547b18dac5c32da42b18
evidence.observation: 18/18 expected source API/policy signatures found across six modules. This proves source-level availability, not runtime.

evidence.environment: Local isolated Python sandbox, no private Lab checkout
evidence.observation: The initial authenticated-runner implementation compiled; the subsequently committed runner still requires execution under a private Lab environment.

limitations: Actual Word Math and connected-system code has NOT executed against a private Lab checkout during this ChatGPT session.
The public harness includes only synthetic fixtures and API references, not any private Lab source.
A side-by-side measurement of Word Math and validation routing is not proof of an existing feed-forward coupling between them.
Any claims about live agent orchestration, mutable Lab state or downstream learning remain UNKNOWN.
next_actions: Run the actual five read-only probes in a private authenticated Lab checkout and inspect the complete results.
Contrast positive, negative, conditional and order-reversed fixtures and investigate failures rather than counting mocked expectations as runtime proof.
After results are reported, publish a sanitized evidence summary for review and consider additional target systems.
Check static inspection.json source fingerprints against any newer private Lab master before treating the experiment as current.
recommendation_reason: The test matrix has current source-level grounding, but lacks real Lab runtime outcome evidence.
